description: This file contains unit tests for testing static content file management such as images and ZIP files in the SalesManager application's content service. It verifies adding, retrieving, and removing static content files through the ContentService interface.

classes.name: StaticContentTestCase
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing static content handling (images, ZIP files, multiple files) in the content service within the SalesManager application.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Tests uploading, retrieving, and deleting an image file in the content service.

methods.name: testCreateStaticContent
methods.description: Tests uploading a static ZIP file content to the content service.

methods.name: testCreateMultipleStaticContent
methods.description: Tests uploading multiple static files (ZIP and DOC) and handling them via the content service.
